Restarting the app or device never resumes simulation. Reopen the app to prepare unattended automation, then send fresh requests.

Allow simulation enables manual starts and automation requests. Keep stopped blocks both.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Tiles by OpenFreeMap; rendered by MapLibre. The map provider receives your IP address and viewed map area. Genuine location is only shown while this screen is open and is never saved as location history. App backup and device transfer are disabled.

Enabled integrations will be able to start simulation at your selected location after the configured delay, without another tap. Keep stopped always blocks requests.
An ongoing notification remains while automation is prepared. Changing this setting stops simulation and clears pending requests. Android may stop the service; reopen MockGPS to prepare it again and send a fresh request.
